title: Home / Landing
desc: Marketing landing page: value proposition, feature highlights, per-student pricing and a Contact call-to-action.

title: Features
desc: Grid of the twelve platform modules available to every school.

title: Pricing
desc: Flat pricing (৳10 per student, manual payment) with an inclusions list.

title: Admissions Directory
desc: Searchable directory of every school currently accepting online admissions.

title: Online Admission Form
desc: A school's public application form; classes come from that school's own class list.

title: Track Application
desc: Applicant status page reached with the unguessable tracking token.

title: Admit Card
desc: Printable admit card issued to the applicant on submission.

title: Top Teachers Leaderboard
desc: Platform-wide ranking of top-rated teachers (photo, name, school, rating). Needs 5+ ratings.

title: Top Schools Leaderboard
desc: Schools ranked by the average of their teachers' ratings (logo, name, address, rating).

title: Contact
desc: Enquiry form; submissions become leads on the Super Admin dashboard. Shows phone, email and topic.

title: Sign In
desc: Single sign-in for every role; routing to the right dashboard happens after login.

title: Platform Dashboard
desc: Platform KPIs (schools, students, revenue), the Contact-messages inbox with clickable phone, and recent schools.

title: Schools
desc: All tenant schools with search and status filter; entry point to create or manage a school.

title: School Detail
desc: A tenant's profile, stats and status controls, plus 'Manage this school' to enter its workspace.

title: Create School
desc: Manually provision a school + admin login, device brand and API key.

title: Contact Messages
desc: Full CRUD over contact leads: search, filter, phone/email links, handle/convert/delete.

title: Contact Message Detail
desc: One lead in full, with convert-to-school, handled toggle, edit and delete.

title: Subscription Plans
desc: Manage subscription plan definitions.

title: Dashboard
desc: Overview: student/teacher/room counts, fees collected, recent students and quick actions.

title: Setup Wizard
desc: Guided checklist to get the school configured.

title: Teachers
desc: Teacher directory with search (name/email/ID) and filters (designation, status).

title: Add Teacher
desc: Create a teacher: account details, designation, subjects, sections and status.

title: Teacher Detail
desc: Teacher profile, rating summary and assigned classrooms.

title: Designations
desc: Per-school staff designation ladder used for the teacher hierarchy.

title: Students
desc: Student directory with search and class/section/status filters.

title: Add Student
desc: Full student admission form.

title: Student Detail
desc: Profile, guardians, invoices, results, plus actions: ID card, admission slip, login, certificate.

title: Student Portal Login
desc: Issue or reset a student's portal login; the login ID is permanent.

title: Admission Applications
desc: Inbox of online applications with status counters, search and filter.

title: Review Application
desc: Approve (placing the applicant into a class/section as a Student) or reject with a reason.

title: Admission Form Settings
desc: Choose the online form or a downloadable PDF form, and set applicant instructions.

title: Certificates
desc: Issued certificates / testimonials / transfer certificates, searchable.

title: Issue Certificate
desc: Compose a certificate with per-type default text and {placeholders}.

title: Academic Years
desc: Academic sessions; one marked current.

title: Classes
desc: Grade levels.

title: Sections
desc: Sections per class/year with an optional class teacher.

title: Subjects
desc: Subject catalog, searchable.

title: Class Routine Builder
desc: Weekly timetable grid per section: period, time, subject, teacher, room and break rows.

title: Classrooms
desc: Collaborative subject rooms with search and subject filter.

title: Classroom Cards
desc: Card view of classrooms for the signed-in user (all rooms for admins).

title: Classroom Detail
desc: Room feed, notes, assignments and participants (tabbed).

title: Assignment & Grading
desc: One assignment with its submissions, marks and feedback entry.

title: Exams
desc: Exam sessions.

title: Exam Detail
desc: Exam subjects and the entry point to marks entry.

title: Attendance
desc: Manual daily attendance by section and date.

title: Staff Attendance
desc: Daily staff register with per-teacher present flag, check-in and check-out.

title: Fingerprint IDs
desc: Map device fingerprint ids to students/teachers for biometric attendance.

title: Attendance Device
desc: Configure the biometric brand, API key, ingest URL/token and view recent punches.

title: Fee Types
desc: Built-in and custom fee categories.

title: Fee Structures
desc: Per-class amounts for each fee type.

title: Invoices
desc: Invoices with search, status filter and receipt links.

title: Invoice Detail
desc: Line items, totals, payment recording and receipt.

title: Teacher Ratings
desc: Ranked teacher ratings leaderboard for the school.

title: Rating Periods
desc: Rating windows during which students can rate teachers.

title: Notifications
desc: In-app notification log.

title: Settings
desc: School profile summary.

title: Money Receipt
desc: Print-ready fee receipt with school branding, line items, paid/due stamp.

title: Student ID Card
desc: CR80 ID card with photo, class/roll, admission number and QR code.

title: Admission Slip
desc: Admission slip: student info, portal login and fee schedule/balance.

title: Certificate
desc: Ornamental printable certificate with substituted placeholders.

title: Dashboard
desc: Teacher home: classrooms, pending grading, subjects.

title: My Classrooms
desc: The classrooms this teacher teaches.

title: My Teaching Routine
desc: The teacher's own weekly schedule, derived from the routine grid.

title: Marks Entry
desc: Exams the teacher can open to enter marks.

title: My Ratings
desc: The teacher's own rating summary (unlocks at 5 ratings).

title: Dashboard
desc: Student home: upcoming assignments, fees due, classrooms.

title: My Class Routine
desc: The student's section timetable with subject, teacher and room.

title: Assignments
desc: Assignments with submission status.

title: Results
desc: Published exam results.

title: Fees
desc: The student's invoices with receipt links.

title: Rate Teachers
desc: Anonymous 6-dimension teacher rating form.

title: Dashboard
desc: Parent home: child cards linking to attendance, results and fees.

title: Attendance
desc: Child attendance calendar.

title: Results
desc: Child exam results.

title: Fees
desc: Child invoices with receipt links.
